movies.title: Hope
movies.plot: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

cinemas.name: Sinema Transtopia
cinemas.address: Otto Braunstr 72 (Haus der StatistikHaus B), 10178 Berlin

movies.title: Hamnet
movies.plot: The powerful story of love and loss that inspired the creation of Shakespeare's timeless masterpiece, Hamlet.
movies.tagline: Keep your heart open.

movies.title: Eternity
movies.plot: In an afterlife where souls have one week to decide where to spend eternity, Joan is faced with the impossible choice between the man she spent her life with and her first love, who died young and has waited decades for her to arrive.
movies.tagline: You can only choose one.

movies.title: On the Sea
movies.plot: Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan’s three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom’s resistance to follow in his footsteps creates familial tension. Tensions are further inflamed by the arrival of an itinerant deckhand, Daniel, who makes known his feelings for Jack. In this remote, rural community where life revolves around Church and fishery, Jack is faced with an impossible dilemma. On The Sea is a beautiful, sensual and at times, tragic exploration of masculinity, place and desire.

movies.title: Fantasy
movies.plot: Mihrije, Sina, and Jasna are best friends in their early twenties who live in Slovenia. They are tomboys and refuse to conform to the conservative system they live in. Their world turns upside down when they meet Fantasy, a transgender woman. Together, they embark on a journey that explores the complexities of gender, desire, and self-discovery.

movies.title: On the Road - En el Camino
movies.criticTitle: On the Road - En el Camino
sourceTitles: On the Road - En el Camino
movies.plot: Veneno, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets Muñeco, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk.

movies.title: Iván & Hadoum
movies.plot: Iván (33), a trans man, and Hadoum (30), a Spanish-Moroccan woman, fall in love at the industrial greenhouse they work in. While facing the opposition from their families and co-workers, Iván realizes he doesn’t need to be the man he is expected to be.

movies.title: Jim Queen
movies.plot: When Heterosis - a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.
movies.tagline: For better or for Queer.

movies.title: Departures
movies.plot: A newly arrived Turkish immigrant faces a series of mounting challenges on her path to reunite with her husband in America.

movies.title: Skiff
movies.plot: Fifteen-year-old Malou is struggling with herself; while her mother is mostly absent and her rowing teammates bully her, the one person she can rely on is her brother Max. When Malou develops feelings for Max’s girlfriend Nouria, her life is dragged in an unstoppable current. Malou has to face her true self, may it be at the expense of her brother.

movies.title: Taxi Driver
movies.plot: Suffering from insomnia, disturbed loner Travis Bickle takes a job as a New York City cabbie, haunting the streets nightly, growing increasingly detached from reality as he dreams of cleaning up the filthy city.
movies.tagline: On every street in every city in this country, there's a nobody who dreams of being somebody. He's a lonely forgotten man desperate to prove that he's alive.

movies.title: JFK Revisited: Die Wahrheit über den Mord an John F. Kennedy
movies.criticTitle: JFK Revisited: Die Wahrheit über den Mord an John F. Kennedy
movies.altTitle: JFK Revisited: Through The Looking Glass
sourceTitles: JFK Revisited: Die Wahrheit über den Mord an John F. Kennedy
movies.originalTitle: JFK Revisited: Through the Looking Glass
movies.plot: Thirty years after the release of his film JFK (1991), filmmaker Oliver Stone reviews recently declassified evidence related to the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, which took place in Dallas on November 22, 1963.
movies.tmdbTitle: JFK Revisited: Through the Looking Glass
movies.tagline: The lie that deceived a nation

movies.title: Lula
movies.plot: An intimate and revelatory portrait of one of the world’s most influential political figures, Lula explores the rise, fall and triumphant return of beloved Brazilian leader Luiz Inácio “Lula” da Silva, chronicling his extraordinary journey in 2022 to regain the Brazilian presidency after spending nineteen months in prison.

movies.title: Die Passion nach G.H.B.
movies.plot: As rain falls in São Paulo, in an unassuming apartment building a random Grindr hookup is multiplying into a frenzied orgy. Over the course of a day and into the night, Matias and his new lovers connect over fucking, a cornucopia of drugs, and classic literature. Matias confides in his companions about his life — his HIV status, his old lovers, his relationship with drugs — while he ponders what the future holds in a fast-changing, post-pandemic world. In his heightened state, Matias is visited by the apparition of G.H., the titular figure from Clarice Lispector‘s landmark novel The Passion According to G.H.

movies.title: Coyote Vs. Acme
movies.plot: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.
movies.tagline: The movie ACME doesn't want you to see.
keywords: based on magazine, newspaper or article

movies.title: Shrek - Der tollkühne Held
movies.plot: It ain't easy bein' green -- especially if you're a likable (albeit smelly) ogre named Shrek. On a mission to retrieve a gorgeous princess from the clutches of a fire-breathing dragon, Shrek teams up with an unlikely compatriot -- a wisecracking donkey.
movies.tagline: The greatest fairy tale never told.

movies.title: Spa Weekend
movies.plot: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.
movies.tagline: Friendship is a real trip.

movies.title: Runner
movies.plot: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.
movies.tagline: Next-day delivery isn't an option.

movies.title: Kuzma
movies.plot: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

movies.title: Lost Highway
movies.plot: A tormented jazz musician finds himself lost in an enigmatic story involving murder, surveillance, gangsters, doppelgängers, and an impossible transformation inside a prison cell.
movies.tagline: A lost road on the edge of strange...

movies.title: Mirzapur: The Movie
movies.plot: The battle for Mirzapur's throne escalates as old enemies resurface and new threats emerge. Blood debts must be paid while power-hungry contenders fight to control the city's violent underworld.
movies.tagline: Witness the epic untold story.

movies.title: GHOST: 2 Big To Rig
movies.plot: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

movies.title: Maspalomas
movies.plot: After breaking up with his partner, 76 year-old Vicente leads life the way he likes it in Maspalomas: he spends his days lying in the sun, partying, and looking for pleasure. An unexpected accident obliges him to return to San Sebastián and to the daughter he abandoned years ago. Vicente will have to live in a retirement home where he finds himself driven back into the closet and to conceal a part of himself that he thought was long resolved. In this new environment, Vicente must ask himself if he has enough time left to make his peace with others… and with himself.

movies.title: Cooking up Democracy
movies.plot: Nowhere else does the experimental kitchen of digital democracy simmer as intensely as in the geopolitically threatened island republic of Taiwan. The "recipes" for these menus were created by activist students from the open-source community. Visionary Digital Minister Audrey Tang is spreading the concept internationally. At the heart of the film, however, are the creative cooks of the LGBTQI+ community and the emerging environmental movement.

movies.title: No Other Choice
movies.plot: After being laid off and humiliated by a ruthless job market, a veteran paper mill manager descends into violence in a desperate bid to reclaim his dignity.
movies.tagline: Would you kill for a job?

movies.title: Morgen ist auch noch ein Tag
movies.criticTitle: Morgen ist auch noch ein Tag
sourceTitles: Morgen ist auch noch ein Tag
movies.plot: In postwar Rome, a working-class woman dreams of a better future for herself and her daughter while facing abuse at the hands of her domineering husband. When a mysterious letter arrives, she discovers the courage to change the circumstances of her life.
movies.tagline: The Italian phenomenon.

movies.title: Lethal Weapon - Zwei stahlharte Profis
movies.plot: A veteran cop and an unstable detective become partners who must put their differences aside in order to bring down a heroin-smuggling ring run by ex-Special Forces.
movies.tagline: If these two can learn to stand each other... the bad guys don't stand a chance.

movies.title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
movies.plot: After getting a flat tire in the middle of nowhere, newly engaged couple Brad and Janet encounter the eerie mansion of the flamboyant, seductive Dr Frank-N-Furter and a variety of eccentric characters. Through elaborate dance and rock music, the mad scientist unveils his latest creation: a perfect, muscular man.
movies.tagline: A different set of jaws.

movies.title: In die Sonne schauen
movies.plot: Four adolescent girls each spend their youth in the same farmhouse over the last century. Though separated by decades, resonances between their lives emerge: their desires and distress, secrets and truths, encounters with another’s gaze and defiant gaze in return.
movies.tagline: The past doesn't fade. It echoes.

movies.title: Bugonia
movies.plot: Two conspiracy obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.
movies.tagline: Of all the abductions, this one is different.

movies.title: Dangerous Minds - Wilde Gedanken
movies.plot: Former Marine Louanne Johnson lands a gig teaching in a pilot program for bright but underachieving teens at a notorious inner-city high school. After having a terrible first day, she decides she must throw decorum to the wind. When Johnson returns to the classroom, she does so armed with a no-nonsense attitude informed by her military training and a fearless determination to better the lives of her students -- no matter what the cost.
movies.tagline: She broke the rules... and changed their lives.

movies.title: Solo Sunny
movies.plot: Sunny is the singer of a band trying to establish itself in the East Berlin music scene. They play regular gigs in small towns, but Sunny feels out of touch with the audience and with her life as a whole. She begins a relationship with Ralph, an amateur saxophonist and philosophy student, who writes her a very personal song—but his obsession with death and unfaithful lifestyle are not for her. After getting into a quarrel with a band member who harasses her and telling off a show host, she is thrown out of the band. Abandoned, she struggles to regain control over her life.

movies.title: Und es war Sommer - Dieter Thomas Kuhn & Band
sourceTitles: Und es war Sommer - Dieter Thomas Kuhn & Band
movies.originalTitle: Und es war Sommer - Dieter Thomas Kuhn & Band
movies.tmdbTitle: Und es war Sommer - Dieter Thomas Kuhn & Band

movies.title: Dirty Dancing
movies.plot: Expecting the usual tedium that accompanies a summer in the Catskills with her family, 17-year-old Frances 'Baby' Houseman is surprised to find herself stepping into the shoes of a professional hoofer—and unexpectedly falling in love.
movies.tagline: First dance. First love. The time of your life.

movies.title: Scherbenland
movies.plot: Spanning 50 years, the documentary traces a path through the Berlin district of Kreuzberg, linking the legacy of the rock band "Ton Steine Scherben" - best known for their work in the 1970s - with their successors.

movies.title: Call me by your Name
movies.plot: In the summer of 1983, a 17-year-old Elio spends his days in his family's villa in Italy. One day Oliver, a graduate student, arrives to assist Elio's father, a professor of Greco-Roman culture. Soon, Elio and Oliver discover a summer that will alter their lives forever.
movies.tagline: Is it better to speak or die?

movies.title: One Battle After Another
movies.plot: Washed-up revolutionary Bob exists in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited, self-reliant daughter, Willa. When his evil nemesis resurfaces after 16 years and she goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her, father and daughter both battling the consequences of his past.
movies.tagline: Some search for battle, others are born into it...

movies.title: Flesh & Fuel
movies.plot: A lonely French trucker's routine life on the road takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a Polish driver. As feelings develop, he struggles to balance his demanding job with a chance at love, determined to make their connection work.

movies.title: The Chronology of Water
movies.plot: Plagued by an abusive childhood, a woman finds escape in competitive swimming, sexual experimentation, toxic relationships, and addiction before ultimately finding her voice through writing.
movies.tagline: It takes many miles to swim to a self.

movies.title: Siri Hustvedt - Dance Around The Self
movies.criticTitle: Siri Hustvedt - Dance Around The Self
sourceTitles: Siri Hustvedt - Dance Around The Self
Siri Hustvedt - Dance Around the Self
movies.originalTitle: Siri Hustvedt – Dance Around the Self
movies.plot: Sabine Lidl presents Siri Hustvedt’s journey from her first novel to being a leading voice in contemporary literature – a film about feminist perspectives, Hustvedt’s soulmate Paul Auster, and the power of thought.
movies.tmdbTitle: Siri Hustvedt – Dance Around the Self

movies.title: Magnolien aus Stahl
movies.plot: A young beautician, newly arrived in a small Louisiana town, finds work at the local salon, where a small group of women share a close bond of friendship and welcome her into the fold.
movies.tagline: Six extraordinary friends. They share each other's laughter. They dry each other's tears.

movies.title: Disclosure Day - Der Tag der Wahrheit
movies.criticTitle: Disclosure Day - Der Tag der Wahrheit
sourceTitles: Disclosure Day - Der Tag der Wahrheit
movies.plot: If you found out we weren’t alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you?
movies.tagline: We deserve to know.

movies.title: The Image
movies.plot: An artist's painting comes to life, and haunts him.

movies.title: Die Bestie mit dem Skalpell
movies.plot: A surgeon discovers that he can restore the beauty to his girlfriend's scarred face by murdering other women and extracting fluids from their pituitary gland. However, the effects only last for a short time, so he has to kill more and more women. It is ultimately a killing spree which ends with considerable death and disaster.
movies.tagline: where will the bodies turn up next? ...under a car seat? ...in a valise? ...or in a deep-freeze?

movies.title: Chéri, ich komme! - Die Erfindung der Lust
movies.criticTitle: Chéri, ich komme! - Die Erfindung der Lust
sourceTitles: Chéri, ich komme! - Die Erfindung der Lust
movies.plot: Based on the true story of a married couple who invented a groundbreaking sex toy heralded as forever changing the way women experience pleasure.

movies.title: Evil Dead Burn
movies.plot: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.
movies.tagline: Every family has its demons.

movies.title: Where the Waves Took Her
movies.plot: For many, crossing the Mediterranean is their last hope of escaping war, persecution, and hunger. As more and more women are forced to take this deadly route, a midwife is now a permanent member of the crew of a sea rescue ship. While midwife Anne-Katrin takes part in her first mission, survivors recount the horrors of their journey. Their worlds briefly collide before the rescued women step into another uncertain future.

movies.title: Michael
movies.plot: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.
movies.tagline: Discover the making of a king.

movies.title: Etwas ganz Besonderes
movies.plot: As a contestant in a singing casting show, Lea is asked by the TV team who she is and what makes her special. She doesn't know and begins to slip into different roles in her search for what makes her special, developing an unexpected fascination for her aunt Kati. Kati's return home as head architect for the renovation of the Residenzschloss after many years abroad reunites the family in one place. This reunion raises the hopes of grandparents Friedrich and Christel that they can join forces to give their pension, which has few visitors, a new lease of life.

movies.title: Glennkill: Ein Schafskrimi
movies.plot: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.
movies.tagline: A new breed of mystery.

movies.title: Lebensansichten eines Huhns
movies.plot: Escaping from a chicken farm, a hen finds refuge in the courtyard of a crumbling restaurant. There, she discovers love, confronts the pecking order, and fights to protect her eggs from a greedy owner. Her droll yet touching quest for motherhood mirrors the messy compromises and silent struggles of human lives.

movies.title: Cliffhanger - Nur die Starken überleben
movies.plot: A year after losing his friend in a tragic 4,000-foot fall, former ranger Gabe Walker and his partner, Hal, are called to return to the same peak to rescue a group of stranded climbers, only to learn the climbers are actually thieving hijackers who are looking for boxes full of money.
movies.tagline: Hang on.

movies.title: Filmmaker's Choice: Im Prinzip haben wir nichts gegen Arbeit
sourceTitles: Filmmaker's Choice: Im Prinzip haben wir nichts gegen Arbeit

movies.title: Unter dir die Stadt
movies.plot: A man and a woman at an art exhibition share a fleeting moment of attraction, which neither can act upon. Days later, a chance second meeting leads to an innocent coffee and the two strangers – both married - toy with their unexplainable fascination for each other. Svenja is curious and finds herself in a hotel room with Roland, but she does not consummate an affair. A powerful executive at the large bank where Svenja's husband works, Roland is used to getting what he wants. He manipulates the transfer of her husband to Indonesia to replace a recently murdered bank manager. Unaware of Roland’s actions, Svenja now ceases to resist...

movies.title: All my Sisters
movies.plot: Growing up in Tehran, a capital of the 21st century... From 2007 to 2025, within a loving family, eighteen years in the life of three sisters, from their early childhood to their daily lives as young women in search of freedom. Brought up in the traditional way, witnessing the struggles of a youth in perpetual movement, what is their future in today's Iranian society?

movies.title: Backrooms: Everything must go
movies.plot: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.  Now including an additional 16 minutes of new, theatrically exclusive post-credit bonus footage from Kane Parsons.

movies.title: Chihiros Reise ins Zauberland
movies.plot: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.
movies.tagline: Beyond the tunnel was a mysterious town.

movies.title: Ice Cream Man
movies.plot: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.
movies.tagline: We all scream.

movies.title: Nürnberg
movies.plot: In postwar Germany, an American psychiatrist must determine whether Nazi prisoners are fit to go on trial for war crimes, and finds himself in a complex battle of intellect and ethics with Hermann Göring, Hitler's right-hand man.
movies.tagline: Judgment is coming.

movies.title: Spaziergang nach Syrakus
movies.plot: In the middle of his life, Paul Gompitz from Rostock makes the decision to travel to Syracuse in Sicily. He is driven to follow in the footsteps of the poet Johann Gottlieb Seume. But: Paul lives in the GDR, behind the most annoying border in the world. His plan is impossible by legal means. So he has to prepare an escape.

movies.title: The Love That Remains
movies.plot: Anna and Magnús are separating, working out how best to navigate breaking up without confusing their three children. Over the course of one year, life continues, in many ways, as normal, with each change of season occasioning little differences at home and in the surrounding landscape.

movies.title: Was haben wir gelacht
movies.plot: An entire generation of Germans was raised on male comedians. But what about their female counterparts? Maren Kroymann, Hella von Sinnen, Bettina Böttinger, Esther Schweins, and Gaby Köster look back at the way women were portrayed on TV in the 1990s and early 2000s, when jokes at women’s expense were the order of the day.

movies.title: Akira
movies.plot: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath that only two teenagers and a group of psychics can stop.
movies.tagline: Neo-Tokyo is about to E.X.P.L.O.D.E.

movies.title: Kusama: Infinity
movies.plot: Now one of the world’s most celebrated artists, Yayoi Kusama broke free of the rigid society in which she was raised, and overcame sexism, racism, and mental illness to bring her artistic vision to the world stage. At 88 she lives in a mental hospital and continues to create art.

movies.title: Paprika
movies.plot: Dr. Atsuko Chiba is a research psychologist who uses a device called the DC Mini to enter her patients' dreams, wherein she adopts the alter-ego "Paprika". When the device is stolen, she must stop rogue elements from merging the dream and waking worlds.
movies.tagline: This is your brain on anime.

movies.title: Rabin's Murder: Chossing to look away
sourceTitles: Rabin's Murder: Chossing to look away

movies.title: Lolita lesen in Teheran
movies.plot: In 1979, amidst censorship and religious extremism, a revolutionary literature professor in Tehran gathers seven of her most dedicated female students to immerse themselves in banned literary classics.

movies.title: Mit leiser Stimme
movies.plot: Back in Tunisia for her uncle's funeral, Lilia reunites with a family that knows nothing about her life in Paris, particularly her romantic life. Determined to uncover the mystery behind her uncle's sudden death, Lilia finds herself confronted with family secrets.

movies.title: It's Never Over, Jeff Buckley
movies.plot: Rising musician Jeff Buckley had only released one album when he died suddenly in 1997. Now, never-before-seen footage, exclusive voice messages, and accounts from those closest to him offer a portrait of the captivating singer.

movies.title: Queer Short Films
movies.originalTitle: Queer as F**k: Bizarre Short Films
movies.plot: These sexy and surreal shorts from innovative gay filmmakers feature party-loving plastic dolls, domineering moms, mad scientists, stuttering sidekicks and adorable break-dancing foreign exchange students! "Jeffrey's Hollywood Screen Trick," "Shame No More," "Pyongyang Robogirl, Soda Pop," "The Trey Billings Show" and the bonus film "Dirty Baby Does Fire Island" are among the funny, provocative, award-winning films in this collection.
movies.tmdbTitle: Queer as F**k: Bizarre Short Films
movies.tagline: Sexy and surreal shorts from innovative gay filmmakers

movies.title: Double Feature: Du coté de Robinson + Le père noel a les yeux bleus
sourceTitles: Double Feature: Du coté de Robinson + Le père noel a les yeux bleus

movies.title: Evidence
movies.plot: Detectives use clues from various recording devices to piece together events surrounding a massacre involving bus passengers at an abandoned gas station.
movies.tagline: Murder is his art

movies.title: La Rosiére de Pessac
movies.plot: This landmark documentary by Jean Eustache, filmed in 1968, hilariously exposes small-town pomposity and naiveté as it chronicles the preparations for an annual contest to crown a village’s most virtuous young woman.

movies.title: Noga
movies.plot: Fearless alternative pop singer Noga Erez is on the brink of superstardom with a unique, captivating sound and a major studio album on the way. But when war erupts and cracks appear in her relationship, Noga must redefine her role as an artist on a global stage.

movies.title: Der fünfte Reiter ist die Angst
movies.criticTitle: Der fünfte Reiter ist die Angst
sourceTitles: Der fünfte Reiter ist die Angst
movies.plot: In Nazi-occupied Czechoslovakia, a doctor-turned-warehouse employee reluctantly agrees to treat a gravely wounded political fugitive, putting himself and everyone living in his building complex in danger.

movies.title: Schönheit & Vergänglichkeit
movies.plot: Sven Marquardt might be the most famous bouncer worldwide. But beside standing in front of the legendary techno club Berghain in Berlin, he is also a well-known and skilled photographer. Long before the Berlin Wall came down, Marquardt portrayed the subcultural East-Berlin scene. His black and white photography illustrates it as voluptuous, laid-back, dirty and existential. Even if shot by daylight, his work is permeated by darkness, ecstasy and night.

movies.title: Eraserhead
movies.plot: First-time father Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newly born mutant child.
movies.tagline: Where your nightmares end...

movies.title: Der Astronaut - Project Hail Mary
movies.plot: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.
movies.tagline: Believe in the Hail Mary.

movies.title: A nice Indian Boy
movies.plot: When Naveen brings his fiancé Jay home to meet his traditional Indian family, they must contend with accepting his white-orphan-artist boyfriend and helping them plan the Indian wedding of their dreams.
movies.tagline: First comes love. Then comes chaos.

movies.title: Possession
movies.plot: A young woman left her family for an unspecified reason. The husband determines to find out the truth and starts following his wife. At first, he suspects that a man is involved. But gradually, he finds out more and more strange behaviors and bizarre incidents that indicate something more than a possessed love affair.
movies.tagline: Inhuman ecstasy fulfilled.

movies.title: Ghost School
movies.plot: Carola is a mischievous girl who doesn't care much for school- except for sports and recess, of course. Without her good friend Willi to keep her on the straight and narrow, she would really be in trouble. One day at school, Carola has an idea. She invents what she calls "International Ghosts' Day" and a ghost named "Buh" to go with it. When Buh turns out to be less-than-imaginary the two decide to switch places, with Buh taking on all the schoolwork, and Carola taking the opportunity to play practical jokes on all her friends...
